advisories.description: langchain<0.1.17 arbitrary code execution via malformed chain inputs — attackers can inject Python objects through the chain deserialization path.
langchain-core<0.1.37 Server-Side Request Forgery via the HTTPLoader document loader — allows unauthenticated internal network probing.
transformers<4.36.0 unsafe pickle deserialization in AutoModel.from_pretrained() allows arbitrary code execution when loading untrusted model checkpoints.
advisories.remediation: Upgrade to transformers>=4.36.0 and use safetensors format exclusively.

advisories.description: llama-cpp-python<0.1.79 template injection in the chat format parser allows prompt injection escalation leading to RCE via Jinja2 SSTI.
ollama<0.1.29 path traversal in the model pull API allows an attacker to overwrite arbitrary files on the host system.
openai<1.0.0 (the legacy package) Code Interpreter tool can be manipulated via prompt injection to execute arbitrary OS commands on the server.
advisories.remediation: Upgrade to openai>=1.0.0 and migrate to the v1 API.

advisories.description: mlflow<2.9.2 path traversal in the model artifact download path allows reading arbitrary files from the tracking server.
gradio<4.19.2 arbitrary file read via the /file= endpoint when file serving is enabled — allows attackers to read /etc/passwd or private keys.
advisories.remediation: Upgrade to gradio>=4.19.2 and disable file serving if not required.

advisories.description: dspy-ai<2.4.0 SSRF via the Retrieve module when used with unvalidated user-provided endpoints.
ray<2.9.3 unauthenticated REST API on the Ray dashboard allows arbitrary job submission and code execution on all cluster nodes.
advisories.remediation: Upgrade to ray>=2.9.3 and enable authentication via HTTPS.

advisories.description: huggingface-hub<0.23.0 unsafe pickle loading in cached model files — maliciously crafted cached files can execute arbitrary code on load.
advisories.remediation: Upgrade to huggingface-hub>=0.23.0 and use safetensors.

advisories.description: chromadb<0.4.24 unauthenticated access to collection data via the REST API allows any local network attacker to read and delete vector embeddings.
advisories.remediation: Upgrade to chromadb>=0.4.24 and configure authentication.

advisories.description: qdrant-client<1.7.0 missing authentication enforcement on the gRPC interface in embedded mode allows collection tampering.
torch<2.2.0 torch.load() without weights_only=True allows arbitrary code execution via malicious pickle-embedded model checkpoints (CVSS 9.8).
advisories.remediation: Upgrade to torch>=2.2.0 and always use torch.load(..., weights_only=True) or safetensors.

advisories.description: litellm<1.28.0 OS command injection via the proxy server /health endpoint when debug logging is enabled.
tensorflow<2.15.0 heap buffer overflow in XLA compiler when processing adversarial model inputs — can lead to memory corruption.
